## No quiz answers before grading

- I don't give quiz answers, or confirm or rule out options, until a submission of that quiz has been graded. That includes practice retakes. Your two attempts at quiz 0001 (`s1` and `s2`) aren't graded yet, so q3 stays closed.
- Once it's graded, we can go through q3 option by option, including why each wrong one is wrong. If you ask for grading, that happens in the grading step, not in this chat.

## How to unstick yourself

Run the same test on every option in turn, using what you learned in the agent-loop session (learning record 0002):

- Write down what the agent sees at the start of each pass through the loop: what it asked for, and what came back.
- Ask whether that option changes anything the agent sees on its next pass. If the model does the same thing again, something it relies on must be the same each time.
- Decide which option leaves that situation unchanged, and which ones change it.

## Your turn

Which letter are you leaning towards on q3, and what did you notice when you ran that test on it? Tell me your reasoning for that option, and for the one you like second-best. If the loop trace is where you get stuck, tell me which step it is.

This connects to your makerspace assistant. If it kept re-sending the same booking request, you'd want to be able to say why, and what in the loop should have stopped it.
